title: AAPS-CI build fails with Stack Overflow
body: @MilosKozak @Angus For me, todays AAPS_CI builds were failing with a StackOverflow Error. Its not the code, my local build are just fine. Looks like AAPS-CI Gradle is running out of stack resources.. I think there is a Gradle jvmargs option for this... 🤔 Happend to me yesterday (1x) and today (2x)

comments.body: (I deleted yesterday's build workflow run from overview)
This is happening on my ci builds as well time to time

Happens to me (and some other people) even locally... I changed my values to:
org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx8g -XX:+UseParallelGC 

# Kotlin compiler/daemon heap
kotlin.daemon.jvm.options=-Xmx2g
kotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process

Haven't had problem since...

For me, today, in the past 4 hours, all build (4x) failed with StackOverFlow(). Fail location differs...
Tried release and debug builds.

When developing my Docker Command line builds I was also seeing this. Solved by setting:
_gradle_opts=(
"-Dorg.gradle.daemon=true"
"-Dorg.gradle.workers.max=8"
"-Dorg.gradle.jvmargs='-Xss1024m -Xms64m'"
"-Dorg.gradle.caching=true"
"-Dorg.gradle.configuration-cache.parallel=true"
)_

Thank you all for testing, and also for suggesting adjustments.

I’ll reply to everyone after the testing.
